name: teamwork-skill
description: Codex-first collaboration skills, with Cursor and Claude Code adapters, for Collaborate, case-bundle workflow documents, research, local evidence, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and long-running goals.

interface.shortDescription: Nine focused skills for Collaborate, durable results, research, debugging, review, setup, and goals.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork adds nine focused collaboration skills for adaptive dialogue and brainstorming; cited external research; read-only local evidence; hypothesis-first debugging; executable planning; independent review; project initialization; global refresh; and persistent goals. Named methods use their owning agent role and return capability-blocked when that role is unavailable, while tiny reads, ordinary explanations, simple commands, authorized implementation, and integration stay on Codex's native fast path. Durable workflow state uses case-v2 bundles only. Init and Update can semantically migrate an explicitly authorized legacy project root into case-v2 with cold-archive recovery evidence. A low-cost Writer persists frozen workflow state through controlled transactions. You choose scope and authorize effects; Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to enable full Teamwork for this Codex plugin.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to brainstorm this problem with me and ask the most useful next question.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this current external question from primary sources with linked citations.
